item: RI-WLD12 M68 — is this one place or two?

result_against_RI-WLD12_M68.bar_two_ge_80pct: FAIL — 52.6% of usable frames (10/19), 41.7% of all shipped frames
result_against_RI-WLD12_M68.bar_cue_object_or_landform_ge_70pct: PASS — 8 of 10 'two' answers named an object or a landform
result_against_RI-WLD12_M68.fail_clause_most_common_cue_is_fog_or_co: DOES NOT FIRE — zero frames were decided by colour or fog; the most common cue is a built object (6 of 10)

weakest_point: The strongest argument against my own result is that it measures the pack, not the province. 13 of 24 frames have a foreground boulder within a few metres of the lens and 5 are unreadable — the camera was placed at a computed crossover coordinate with no occlusion test, so more than half the pack is a photograph of a rock. On the frames where the camera could actually see, the borders read well and read as OBJECTS. A reader should treat the 52.6% as a fact about the capture and not yet as a fact about the world.
